family_line.note: The configuration task 012's brief asked for. ANN-Benchmarks has no hnswlib run at efConstruction=200 -- all nine of its run groups use 500 -- so there is no published point to compare any efSearch against, and every point of this curve is couldnt_check. Kept because the brief named it and because the measured column is still worth having beside the M=12 curve.

Achieved 199.99 qps against a 200.0 target; this is a sustain check -- a throttled run cannot exceed what it was offered, so it is not a measurement of the engine's ceiling. See qps_max.

single_node_hnsw[M=32,efConstruction=200,efSearch=128] meets every constraint that could be checked: recall_at_k recall@10 0.9976 >= 0.95; storage_amplification 1.00x stored copies per vector <= 2.0x; latency_p95 p95 38.22 ms <= 40.0 ms on runpod (environment tf8sd2usxbblsm) (from k=10_under_load: under load at concurrency 32); qps sustained the offered 200 qps at concurrency 32: 59999 of 60000 queries in 300 s, short by 1 against a tolerance of 300 (one query per second of duration, the generator's tick), 0 errors (environment tf8sd2usxbblsm). Achieved 199.99 qps against a 200.0 target; this is a sustain check -- a throttled run cannot exceed what it was offered, so it is not a measurement of the engine's ceiling. See qps_max; monthly_budget EUR 140 +/- 35/month; upper bound EUR 175 <= 1200 EUR (1 x eu-generic-4vcpu-16gb at 0.192 EUR/hour x 730 h/month; sized from est_memory_bytes 0.50 GB at 70% headroom; prices declared, as_of 2026-09-11).

These options are indistinguishable on recall: hash_sharded[M=32,efSearch=96,shards=3] 0.9984; single_node_hnsw[M=32,efConstruction=200,efSearch=128] 0.9976. Their recall differs by less than the calibration tolerance (0.01), which is what this project can currently defend, so choosing between them on recall would be reading noise. They are separated only where they differ measurably. Overall: hash_sharded[M=32,efSearch=96,shards=3] couldnt_check; single_node_hnsw[M=32,efConstruction=200,efSearch=128] meets -- indistinguishable on recall is not indistinguishable overall.

Recommended: single_node_hnsw[M=32,efConstruction=200,efSearch=128]. It meets every constraint that could be checked, and was ranked first by: fewest constraints at margin (3: recall_at_k, latency_p95, qps), then lowest storage amplification (1.00x), then lowest fan-out (1).
